page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz and is paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and the CPU allocation is shared.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tier of cloud compute resources. Single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the bottom 25 percent, while multi-core metrics, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 1598.0 and Passmark CPU score of 2646.42, rank in the bottom 10 percent. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with large-block read and write speeds measuring 16.93 GB/sec and 13.99 GB/sec respectively. Despite these limitations, the CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512, and AES cryptography.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest benchmark results, the ecs.mn4.large is positioned as a budget-friendly option for low-intensity workloads. It is suitable for basic web serving, small-scale Redis operations, and lightweight background tasks that do not require sustained high-performance compute or local storage.
